_comment: Eternal Guild — full 78-card Tarot deck. Lean GAME data (id/name/arcana/number/suit/portrait) + a first-draft art_brief per card (art-direction seed for the portrait pipeline — refine freely; feeds tarot-art-bible.md). Portraits are placeholder paths until commissioned. Major Arcana are the hero/evolving cards; Minor Arcana are procedural recruits.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.art_brief: A young heir steps toward a fresh map at the world's edge, bindle on a stick, the chasm yawning below — reckless hope, a guild reborn.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.art_brief: Hands raised over the glowing stone-and-roots pillar, the four suit-tools laid on the bar — will and craft, the tavern as a place things are made to happen.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.art_brief: A veiled keeper seated between two pillars, a Prior tablet in her lap, moonlit teal — the secrets the world forgot it was built on.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.art_brief: A woman crowned in hops and barley before a warm harvest, amber light — plenty, the nurturing heart of the hearth.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.art_brief: The distant monarch on a cold throne of antlers and stone, a mirror-masked shadow at his ear — order that is less free than it believes.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.art_brief: A robed runecaster before an altar of glowing sigils, students kneeling — the Mages Guild that kept the forms and lost the meaning.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.art_brief: Two adventurers at the threshold, hearth-warmth behind, cold road ahead — a bond that dispatch may one day sunder.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.art_brief: An armored rider crossing the hex-map at speed, guild banners snapping — momentum, a mission set in motion.

cards.name: Strength
cards.art_brief: A figure calming the hearth-spirit Onibi with a bare hand, warm ember glow — soft power, mastery without force.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.art_brief: A lone lantern-bearer descending into the dungeon beneath the tavern, Mignola shadow swallowing all but the flame — solitary seeking.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.art_brief: A great turning wheel of tavern signs and fallen guild crests, spinning like the gasha map-reveal — runs rise and fall, the eternal return.

cards.name: Justice
cards.art_brief: A seated arbiter weighing a coin against a grave-token, no dice in sight — the true cost of every dispatch, measured.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.art_brief: A Prior suspended upside-down within a glowing pillar, serene, roots binding the limbs — the surrender that built the world.

cards.name: Death
cards.art_brief: A single empty chair at the tavern, a portrait turned to the wall, one quiet line — not gore but absence; the one who didn't come back.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.art_brief: A brewer pouring between two vessels, fire and water meeting in warm steam — the patient alchemy of the tavern economy.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.art_brief: A mirror-masked figure holding fine chains over willing hands, a false warm serenity — the hidden hand you mistake for comfort.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.art_brief: The stone-and-roots pillar cracking, the tavern floor breaking open onto the dungeon, ink-black lightning — sudden ruin, truth erupting.

cards.name: The Star
cards.art_brief: A shooting-star fire-spirit descending over a quiet hamlet at dusk, teal sky, one warm point of light — hope after the Tower.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.art_brief: A four-winged, bat-eared silhouette against a huge moon, mirror mask catching the light, an uncertain path below — illusion, the architect half-seen.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.art_brief: The guild hall ablaze with warm light, patrons and bard and full tankards, gold linework — earned contentment, a good run.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.art_brief: Five portraits turned face-up above a table, fates spoken, a horn sounding over the chasm — the final reckoning of a life's roster.

cards.name: The World
cards.art_brief: The chosen heir at the edge of a new map, the old tavern's pillar still glowing behind, a full circle of guild crests — an ending that is a beginning.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.art_brief: A single torch thrust up from the hearth, sparks rising — raw ambition, the spark of adventure.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.art_brief: An adventurer on the tavern roof surveying the hex-map, one wand in hand — planning the first venture.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.art_brief: A figure watching caravans depart toward the chasm, three banners planted — waiting on dispatched hopes.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.art_brief: Garlands strung over the guild door, a small celebration in warm light — a homecoming, a milestone reached.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.art_brief: Five recruits sparring rowdily by the fire, staves clashing in play — friction in a crowded roster.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.art_brief: A victorious adventurer returning through cheering patrons, laurel and raised torch — a mission triumphant.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.art_brief: One defender atop a rise holding off six staves from the dark below — holding the line, embattled.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.art_brief: Eight embers streaking across a teal dusk sky toward the hamlet — swift news, fast-moving events.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.art_brief: A bandaged guard leaning on a staff at the tavern door, wary but standing — resilience, one more stand.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.art_brief: A figure bowed under ten heavy staves crossing the threshold — overburdened, too many missions carried at once.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.art_brief: A young hopeful at the notice board, torch aloft, eyes bright — an eager new recruit.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.art_brief: An armored rider charging the map, cloak like flame, reckless grin — headlong ambition.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.art_brief: A warm, commanding hostess by the hearth, black cat at her feet, sunflower in hand — confident radiance.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.art_brief: A seasoned guildmaster on a throne of antlers and embers, staff like a brand — visionary authority.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.art_brief: A single overflowing tankard held up in hearth-light, foam like spilled light — new love, the tavern's welcome.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.art_brief: Two adventurers toasting across a table, a quiet bond forming — partnership, a pledge.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.art_brief: Three friends dancing by the fire, mugs raised, the bard playing — celebration, found family.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.art_brief: A brooding patron ignoring an offered cup, staring into the fire — apathy, a heart withdrawn.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.art_brief: A cloaked figure over three spilled cups, two still standing behind them — grief, but not all is lost.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.art_brief: Two children sharing sweets in a sunlit doorway, nostalgic gold — memory, innocence, the past.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.art_brief: A dreamer before seven glowing cups rising as visions in teal smoke — temptation, too many wants.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.art_brief: A lone figure walking away from eight cups toward the dark hills, lantern low — leaving comfort behind.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.art_brief: A contented host seated before nine full cups, arms crossed, satisfied — earned comfort, a wish granted.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.art_brief: A family silhouetted under a rainbow of ten cups over the hamlet — harmony, the good ending.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.art_brief: A gentle youth offering a cup with a small fish leaping from it — a tender message, quiet wonder.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.art_brief: A calm rider bearing a single cup like an offering, mist-blue — romance, a quest of the heart.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.art_brief: A serene woman on a shore-throne cradling an ornate cup, lost in feeling — empathy, deep intuition.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.art_brief: A steady patriarch on a throne amid restless waves, cup in hand, unmoved — mastered emotion.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.art_brief: A single upright blade crowned in cold light breaking through cloud — clarity, a hard truth.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.art_brief: A blindfolded figure crossing two swords before a moonlit chasm — stalemate, a hard choice deferred.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.art_brief: Three blades through a heart-shaped tavern sign in the rain — heartbreak, a painful loss.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.art_brief: An adventurer resting on a tomb-slab beneath three hung swords, still — recovery, a wounded pause.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.art_brief: A smirking figure gathering swords as others walk away defeated — a hollow victory, discord.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.art_brief: A ferry poling away from the dark shore, six swords upright, hooded passengers — passage, leaving trouble.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.art_brief: A thief slipping from an enemy camp with stolen blades, glancing back — cunning, a risky gambit.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.art_brief: A bound, blindfolded figure ringed by eight swords on a bleak flat — trapped by self-made limits.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.art_brief: A figure sitting up in the dark, hands to face, nine swords on the wall — dread, the sleepless night.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.art_brief: A fallen adventurer beneath ten swords on a cold ridge, teal dawn behind — rock bottom, an end that turns.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.art_brief: A watchful youth on a windswept hill, blade ready, scanning the dark — vigilance, a curious spy.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.art_brief: A rider charging headlong into storm-shadow, blade out, unstoppable — ruthless drive.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.art_brief: A stern arbiter enthroned above the clouds, blade upright, one hand extended — clear-eyed judgment.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.art_brief: A grim ruler on a throne of cold stone, blade held level, unblinking — intellect, hard authority.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A single gold coin offered in an open hand amid a hearth-lit garden — new wealth, a solid start.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A juggler balancing two coins in an endless loop over rough ground — managing scarce gold.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A craftsman fitting stone into the tavern wall as two patrons look on — collaboration, building the guild.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A miser clutching four coins on the tavern step, guarding every one — hoarding, fear of loss.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: Two ragged figures passing a lit tavern window in the snow, coins out of reach — hardship, want.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A merchant weighing coins into open hands, scales balanced — fair exchange, giving and taking.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A farmer leaning on a hoe, eyeing a slow-growing vine of coins — patience, waiting on returns.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A smith hammering coin after coin by lamplight, wholly focused — diligence, honing a craft.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A poised figure in a rich garden, a hawk on the wrist, coins on the vine — earned independence, luxury.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: Elders and children beneath an archway of ten coins and guild banners — legacy, generational wealth.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A student turning a single coin in the light, studious and hopeful — ambition, a plan begun.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A patient rider halted in a plowed field, coin held steady — reliability, unglamorous effort.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A nurturing figure enthroned in a garden, coin in her lap, a rabbit nearby — practical abundance, care.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.art_brief: A prosperous lord on a throne of vines and gold, coin resting in hand, secure — mastery of the material.
